scope: Score every cataloged workflow on 9 productivity dimensions (1-5). Inputs are Phase 0 platform_workflow_code_truth_inventory.json + existing workflow_click_reduction_audit.json. Phase 1 classification matrix and Phase 5/6/7 operator/tenant/studio_os gear-up audits were not present at scoring time, so workflow selection is generated from the inventory + click-reduction list with audience labeled from app surfaces. Read-only walk; no app code executed. Honest scoring: every score is a hypothesis unless cross-referenced against a known scanner gate baseline (e.g. accessibility leans on scan_color_contrast.py baseline=0; mobile_readiness leans on scan_horizontal_overflow_risk.py baseline=0 post v3.57.1 burndown). All scores carry measurement_status: hypothesis unless explicitly tagged otherwise.

global_assumptions.accessibility_floor: scan_color_contrast.py baseline=0 platform-wide -> floor of 3 unless template-level keyboard/aria gap visible
global_assumptions.mobile_readiness_floor: scan_horizontal_overflow_risk.py baseline=0 post v3.57.1 -> floor of 3 unless responsive grammar absent
global_assumptions.tenant_safety_floor: scan_tenant_queryset_safety.py baseline=0 + scan_tenant_isolation_marker_quality.py baseline=0 -> tenant-scoped paths default 4 unless cross-host gap visible
global_assumptions.ai_usefulness_default: 1 if app lacks apicenter import or ai_helpers wire; 2-3 if helper present but rail not route-aware; 4-5 reserved for cockpit ai_copilot_rail with evidence
